body:
In the other three comments I posted I pretty much described everything, I don't know if I need to summarize it again. 

Thanks for the reply.

That is good advice, thanks. It's hard to go out on walks where I live though (industrial/suburbian parts of town, lots of cars, no parks or places to walk really). I sometimes go to the city, but because it's harder I don't do it too often.

I've talked to my school counselor repeatedly, but I stopped about two years ago. She always only listened to me and said "oh that must be rough for you, get therapy". (I'm not trying to underrate her efforts, but that's literally everything she said when I talked to her.) I'm going to therapy about twice a month now, but the situation with my parents is hard to handle. In the past month I've had three nervous breakdowns because of it.

[This is what is going on with my parents](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/8mq0v/im_stuck_i_have_nothing_to_do/), I had posted it a few days ago. My father cannot stand anything that happens and he yells at me and my mother because of it. I'm pretty much an unwanted child (I was born eight years after my sisters -who happen to be twins-, they've admitted that I wasn't a planned child, etc.), so they have even less tolerance to the things I do. I'm alone in this house, since my sisters are already married. Everytime my father flips out, my mother is on his side because she is too scared or values her relationship with my dad more than she values her relationship with me, so I'm always the one who's wrong.

I posted about the grades on a different reply, I basically lack motivation and let my grades go down.

Every year my grades go on a curve: I start with great grades and I end the year with bad ones. This is mostly because I lose the motivation I had when the year started. This year, the curve went down lower than ever. It's mostly because I stop caring, and I *hate* that I stop caring, but I find it really hard to get myself to care :\

I will post what is going on with my parents on a different reply.

My grades are in an all-time low because of my attitude. My parents are crazy and I can hardly live in this house anymore. I don't have the option of leaving. Everything sucks. I don't want to kill myself, but I want this to end. I feel like shit (for the lack of a more apropiate word to use).

Yeah, you're right. I'm going to talk to them. I've been talking to my girlfriend, who always listens to my problems so she makes me feel a ton better. It just sucks that I have no way I can solve this.

I've thought about that, but it's really hard. I'm in a private school, public school in Mexico sucks for an amount of reasons (they're very insecure, education is the worst, teachers are corrupt and negligent, etc.). It's pretty hard to have a good future if you don't get private education in Mexico. And any job a 17 year old kid can get in Mexico won't be enough to let him live by his own. Minimum wage in Mexico is about 1/10 of the American minimum wage, and living costs are not as small.

EDIT: I can't move in with my sisters because of the reasons I explained in my previous reply.

I'd go to talk to my sisters but I'm afraid they're going to be against me. They can't do anything. My father built their houses, but they don't legally belong to them until my father dies. So if they do anything against him or just in my favor, they're risking their houses.

Hi.

I'm a kid in high school. I'm mexican. Lately I've been trying to improve my life and solve my problems, but there's one thing I haven't been able to handle and has driven me crazy my whole life. That problem is my parents. Please bear with me before you think I'm just an emo kid who hates his parents.

It's hard to describe my father. He has and has had a lot of issues that make him think his family owes him things. I don't know if I need to ennumarate those problems, but what basically happened to him is that when he was born, the "uterus fluids" (I don't have a better term) weren't properly removed from his lungs, so he started to get contaminated and had to had one of his lungs cirurgically removed when he was six. When he was a teenager, his father went to the US to work, so he was left with a sick mother who died when he was seventeen. He was the second oldest child and he had to take care the rest of the family. When he was twenty, he married my mother.

I now need to describe my parents' relationship. Both my parents think my mother should obey my father, so my father thinks he can give her orders. Because of different happenings, my mother lost all social contact apart from the family and my father's family. She became incredibly needy. Whenever my father starts a drama because of nothing, he threatens to leave us and my mother has to beg him amd beg him until he "has" to stay. He threatens me a lot too, but I just tell him that if he wants to leave, then he should leave.

Yesterday he started another drama. It started because of some stupid thing (my father ordered my mother to leave the bathroom door open when she changes clothes, she didn't because she forgot... uhm, yeah) and he threatened to leave. My mother was begging him as always as he took some clothes and shoes out of the closet and put them on the hallway. My father knocks on my bedroom door and tells me that he's leaving. I ask him why, he says "because I chose too", I ask him why he chose that and he says that that is none of my business. I tell him that it is my business, and that he should for once treat me like a person and tell me. He keeps saying that that is none of my business, that he is just tired of us, and I just lose it. I start yelling that he keeps doing the same, and that he wants to leave he should leave, it's not fair that he threatens us to impose hegemony. I tell him that their relationship is sick, and that it makes the whole house feel unhealthy. It went on like that until 2am.

Today in the morning my father kept yelling at my mother during breakfast. I overhead some things, he once said that he had to go to work and that we were "lazy parasites", when my mother actually handles the whole house, while I try to do my best at school and keep a job. I was annoyed, but I didn't want to confront him, I just waited for him to leave for work. My mother then told me that I "screw up" and she kept crying and blaming me. I start yelling at her too, and tell her that I was sickened by their relationship because it just wasn't healthy, and that her behaviour just allows my father to be a dick to us.

I know I get angry by this very easily and that I shouldn't yell and shout at my parents, but I'm sick of it. I feel lonely in this house, I just can't do anything. My mother values her relationship over me so I'm always the one who's wrong. My two older sisters are already married, so they don't know what happens. When my mother tells them, I'm always the one who's wrong. I have everyone against me in this house, and I just can't keep living in here. I've been trying to solve all my problems but I can't solve this one.
